acceptance_criteria: The four founder-supplied files are visually classified as LH-003 front, back, wearer-left, and wearer-right physical views.
Original source bytes and SHA-256 values are preserved; canonical repository copies are byte-identical.
The source-photo manifest selects physical photography rather than a techflat for LH-003 front and back.
Directional side views remain distinct while satisfying the generic side-coverage requirement.
The founder-confirmed pocket invariant is explicit everywhere: exactly two side pockets and two rear pockets, with zipper closures on all four pockets.
The dossier records physical front, back, side-panel, pocket, artwork, trim, and wording evidence without inventing unseen construction.
LH-COMMERCE-2 binds all four physical views and retains the approved-wearer and protected-matte blockers.
Catalog, imagery SOT, source-photo, scene-contract, and focused regression checks pass or remain explicitly blocked with evidence.
Independent review remains required before the task can advance beyond NEEDS_REVIEW.

issues.description: The source-photo manifest selected 320x400 techflats even though byte-matched physical front and back product photography was present.
issues.resolution: Canonical selection now prefers the physical front and back sources; the manifest is regenerated deterministically and classifies LH-003 as photography.

issues.description: The dossier omitted the two zippered rear pockets and rear artwork, reversed or under-specified directional side branding, and failed to preserve the founder-confirmed invariant of exactly two zippered side pockets plus two zippered rear pockets.
issues.resolution: Dossier, scene contract, and source-authority receipt now preserve directional artwork and exactly four zippered pockets; a fail-closed regression test guards the correction.

issues.description: Four physical product views improve exact construction authority but do not provide the approved on-model customer or protected garment matte required for final scene generation.

evidence: Four canonical product views are byte-identical to founder-supplied originals.
LH-003 source selection now resolves to physical photography for front, back, wearer-left, and wearer-right.
Founder truth is fail-closed across dossier, contract, receipt, and regression test: two side pockets plus two rear pockets, all four zippered.
Source-photo manifest regeneration is deterministic; LH-003 has front, back, and side coverage while the dedicated detail-pocket macro remains missing.
Independent visual-commerce-qa verdict is PASS_SOURCE_INTAKE_ONLY and recommends no generation, wiring, or promotion.
LH-COMMERCE-2 retains approved-wearer, protected-matte, and candidate-bound paid-preflight blockers.
No render, provider call, Comfy job, credit spend, promotion, wiring, or deployment was performed.
